title: Epistemic Memory: A Validity Layer for Self-Maintaining Intelligent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2510.16899v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI memory mechanisms primarily focus on preserving information content, often neglecting the validity conditions under which knowledge remains applicable, leading to semantic coordinate drift when agents move, change sensors, or encounter novel environments. This paper proposes epistemic memory as a validity-maintenance layer that governs when stored knowledge remains applicable. We formalize the dynamic epistemic quotient, an observation-induced equivalence structure over hypotheses that evolves with an agent's interaction history and sensing capabilities. We derive a pairwise incompatibility lower bound showing that any fixed semantic representation must incur unavoidable error across changing epistemic boundaries. We further identify a failure mode under symmetric crossing quotients, where overlap-based class-level transport becomes independent of pre-transition belief, motivating preservation of within-class hypothesis provenance

translated_title: 认知记忆：自维护智能系统的有效性层
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.16899v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：AI记忆机制主要侧重于保留信息内容，往往忽视了知识适用性的有效性条件，导致当智能体移动、更换传感器或遇到新环境时出现语义坐标漂移。本文提出认知记忆作为有效性维护层，用于管理存储知识何时保持适用。我们形式化了动态认知商，这是一种由观察诱导的关于假设的等价结构，随智能体的交互历史和感知能力演变。我们推导出一个成对不相容下界，表明任何固定的语义表示在变化的认知边界上必然产生不可避免的错误。我们还识别了一种在对称交叉商下的失败模式，其中基于重叠的类级迁移变得独立于转移前的信念，从而促使保留类内假设的来源信息。
tldr: 本文提出认知记忆作为AI系统的有效性维护层，通过动态认知商形式化知识适用条件，并证明固定语义表示在变化环境中存在不可避免的错误，需保留假设来源以应对认知边界变化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes epistemic memory as a validity-maintenance layer for AI systems, formalizing the dynamic epistemic quotient to govern knowledge applicability, proving unavoidable errors for fixed semantic representations across changing epistemic boundaries, and advocating for preserving within-class hypothesis provenance.
